digest.component_or_area: MCP tool registration and plan-review attestation currency check
propositions: MCP agents cannot query attestation currency without provisioning a read-only `plan_review_status` tool, forcing discovery of staleness only through error responses to write operations

The `plan_review_status` read-only MCP tool must delegate to the existing `rebar.llm.plan_review_status` library function and return a structured `PlanReviewStatusOut` model with fields `ok`, `verdict`, `reason`, `verified_at_sha`, and `signed_at`
The tool must be registered only by `register_read_tools` (present under `REBAR_MCP_READONLY`) and absent from write-tool registrars to enforce read-only semantics
Documentation in `docs/mcp-reference.md` must be regenerated by `scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py` to reflect the new read-only tool and remain in sync via CI drift guard
A canonical JSON schema file `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_status.schema.json` must be added and wired via the `PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS` constant to satisfy the MCP output schema coverage guard
Tool registration must be factored into a separate `_register_plan_review_tools` module-level function to keep `register_read_tools` within its McCabe complexity baseline
